{
  "subproblems": [
    "Tokenize the input text into words.",
    "Select tokens that begin with '$'.",
    "Exclude tokens whose remaining characters consist only of punctuation.",
    "Count the frequency of each valid word.",
    "Return None when no valid words remain.",
    "Create a seaborn/matplotlib bar plot with words on the x-axis and frequencies on the y-axis.",
    "Return the resulting matplotlib Axes object."
  ],
  "high_level_plan": [
    "Tokenize the text using NLTK.",
    "Filter tokens beginning with '$' and retain only those containing at least one non-punctuation character.",
    "Build a frequency distribution for the retained tokens.",
    "If the distribution is empty, return None.",
    "Create and label a bar plot from the frequency data.",
    "Return the plot's Axes object."
  ]
}
